en.bdb: Worship of the feet of sadhu

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: rom rom vich rakhion kar brahama(n)dd karoR samaiee|

en.bdb: The Lord has subsumed crores of universes in His each trichome.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham sat purakh satigur sukhadhaiee|

en.bdb: The true Guru form of that primal perfect and transcendental Brahm is bestower of delights.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan gursikh hoi saadhasa(n)gat satigur saranaiee|

en.bdb: All the four vamas come to the shelter of the true Guru in the form of holy congregation

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan simaran sadhaa gurmukh sabadh surat liv laiee|

en.bdb: And the gurmukhs there merge their consciousness in the Word through learning, meditation and, prayer.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੇ ਵਸਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bhai bhagat bhau piram ras satigur moorat ridhe vasaiee|

en.bdb: Fear of the Lord, loving devotion and the delight of love, for them, is the idol of the true Guru whom they cherish in their heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਵਡੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਚਾਇਂਦੇ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਣ ਪੂਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: evadd bhaar uchai(n)dhe saadh charan poojaa gur bhaiee|

en.bdb: The feet of the true Guru in the form of sadhu bear so much load (mental as well as spiritual) of their disciples that,

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal keem na paiee ||14||

en.bdb: 0 my brothers you, ought to worship them. The value of the pleasure fruit of the gunnukhs cannot be estimated.
